description: Change title, description, tags, category, thumbnail or privacy of a video on a connected channel. privacy 'public' is ALWAYS parked for approval and runs only after a human admin approves it - in the app, or on the human's explicit request via resolve_pending_tool_call {human_request} with their own API key (never as an agent). Never deletes.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

privacy.description: New visibility; public is always parked for admin approval

thumbnail_library_slug.description: Use the poster of this video library entry as thumbnail (instead of thumbnail_url)

thumbnail_url.description: https URL of a JPEG/PNG thumbnail (max 2 MB); needs a verified channel

video_id.description: ID of the video to change

name: update_youtube_video
